summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting FDA approval of a label expansion for ASCENIV to include pediatric patients. No M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is described. The event is a routine regulatory milestone for a biopharmaceutical company.
